era: 2019 Business Insider (the 2018 redesign used through 2019): white slim header with the two-line black BUSINESS INSIDER logo left, letter-spaced 11px uppercase nav with thin separators (TECH, FINANCE, POLITICS, STRATEGY, LIFE, ALL; BI PRIME and INTELLIGENCE at right), account, search and edition icons, the leaderboard ad under the header, 'TOP STORY' with a big bold Helvetica headline and blue square bullets, blue-teal letter-spaced section labels. Same page for every visitor (captures from 2019-06, 2019-07 and 2019-11 agree).
